text:
Sam K: starting blue->green for router eu-west1: v2.3.1 -> v2.4-candidate. Plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%, 6m waits. Change window 22:15-23:15 UTC. Pin v2.3.1 as fallback. @Priya R @Lee W ack and monitor.

Priya R: ack. spinning up canary probe and traces. will watch p50/p95 and auth paths.

Lee W: ack. watching edge drain and connection handoffs. pause if errors +2% or p95 +5%.

Sam K: warmed pool and deployed canary.

```
infractl pool create router-v2-4-canary --region eu-west1 --size 3
infractl deploy --svc router --img redwood/router:v2.4-cand --pool router-v2-4-canary
```

deploy-bot: weight update: 0% -> 10% to v2.4-cand applied.

OpsOnCall: initial monitors OK. canary CPU ~28%.

Priya R: probe shows p95 +2.3% and a small TTFB blip for hot keys.

Emily G: correlating, seeing increased KV misses on canary; shard config differs.

Lee W: recommend pause and run targeted cache-warm before further ramp.

Sam K: pausing scheduled increments. running cache-warm.

deploy-bot: scheduled ramp paused by Sam K.

OpsOnCall: cache warm completed. post-warm p95 ~+0.7%.

Sam K: bump to 25% manually.

deploy-bot: weights now v2.3.1=75%, v2.4-cand=25%.

Emily G: at 25% auth 5xx spiked to ~1.2% concentrated on token validation calls.

Priya R: traced to signing lib defaults (shorter timeout). applying config override to canary (increase timeout) and restart.

Sam K: apply override and rolling restart.

deploy-bot: config patch applied; rolling restart succeeded.

OpsOnCall: auth 5xx fell to 0.2%, p95 back ~+1.0%.

Sam K: operational mismatch (cache warm + timeout). proposal: abort tonight's ramp, rollback to v2.3.1, keep pool for diagnostics 24h, cut v2.4.1 with fixes.

Lee W: +1 prefer patch and pin.

Emily G: cutting image ticket RB-4821; will have candidate tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: rolling weights back to stable: v2.3.1=100%, v2.4-cand=0% ... succeeded. draining canary pool.

Priya R: drafting release note: "Paused v2.4 canary after cache warm and signing timeout mismatch. Rolled back to v2.3.1. Actions: add cache-warm to deploy flow and fix signing default. Re-test with v2.4.1."

Sam K: change window remains open but we are not progressing. marking deploy paused and closing thread for tonight. :white_check_mark:
